references.text: Samson told Delilah that seven fresh bowstrings, which had not been dried, would make him weak like an ordinary man. This verse shows the fulfillment of her plan.
A similar pattern repeats itself where Delilah binds Samson with new ropes, and he breaks free. This demonstrates the recurring pattern of deception.
Earlier, Samson was bound with new ropes by men from Judah, but the Spirit of the Lord came upon him and he broke free. This establishes the pattern of Samson's supernatural strength against bonds.
The Philistine rulers asked Delilah to find out the secret behind Samson's strength. This verse shows their first attempt to carry out the plan.
